name: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the intelligent manufacturing and integrated services; and electric vehicle charging network in China and internationally. The company offers high, medium, and low voltage products; electric vehicle (EV) charging networks; oil- and dry-type transformers; smart microgrid carports; and prefabricated, mobile trailer, and skid substations, as well as renewable energy step-up and smart integrated kiosk.
